transcript: Speaker A: Aap subah itni jaldi kahaan ja rahi hain? [Where are you going so early in the morning?] Speaker B: I going market buy vegetables. Speaker A: Ise aise boliye, "I am going to the market to buy vegetables." Speaker B: Mujhe English bolne mein hesitation hota hai. [I feel hesitant speaking English.] Speaker A: Roz thodi practice karengi toh confidence aa jayega. [If you practice a little every day, you will gain confidence.] Speaker B: Par practice kaise karoon? [But how do I practice?] Speaker A: SpeakEasy app ke saath. [With the SpeakEasy app.] Speaker B: Usmein kya hota hai? [What happens in it?] Speaker A: Main aapki AI teacher bankar aapko Hindi mein English samjhaungi aur speaking practice karaungi. [I will become your AI teacher, explain English in Hindi, and make you practice speaking.] Speaker B: Achha, mehnga toh nahi hai? [Oh, is it expensive?] Speaker A: Nahi, sirf ek rupaye se shuruwaat kar sakti hain. [No, you can start with just one rupee.] Speaker B: Main aaj hi install karti hoon. [I will install it today.] Speaker C: Abhi SpeakEasy app download karein aur farratedar English bolna shuru karein. [Download the SpeakEasy app now and start speaking fluent English.]
on_screen_text: Aap subah... I going market buy vegetables... I am going to the market to buy vegetables... Mujhe English bolne mein hesitation hoti hai... Roz thodi practice karengi toh confidence aa jayega... Par practice kaise karoon?... SpeakEasy app ke saath... Usmein kya hota hai?... Main aapki AI teacher bankar aapko Hindi mein English samjhaungi aur speaking practice karaungi... Achha, mehnga toh nahi hai?... Nahi, sirf ek rupaye se shuruwaat kar sakti hain... Main aaj hi install karti hoon... SpeakEasy AI... Speak English Easily with SpeakEasy... Install Now
summary: An AI robot avatar corrects a woman's English grammar during a market walk. She introduces the SpeakEasy app as a budget-friendly AI tutor to practice English daily. The ad concludes with a call to download the app on Google Play.
